title: Household Burden Table for Insulin Pump Program Hardship Waivers
content:
The household burden on a hardship waiver on an Insulin Pump Program follows the customer's other Larkfield programs — the customer's active program on the Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program whose delivery method is insulin pump, and the customer's active program on the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program — and whether each carries a balance above zero:

| Active pump-delivery insulin pharmacy program balance | Active CGM program balance | Effect on the share |
|---|---|---|
| above zero | above zero | the standard share is replaced with 100 percent, the whole waiver base |
| above zero | zero or less, or no active CGM program | 10 points (the burden points) are added to the share |
| zero or less, or no such active insulin pharmacy program | above zero | 10 points (the burden points) are added to the share |
| zero or less, or none | zero or less, or none | nothing is added |

The balances read are the patient balances due on those other programs in active status. An insulin pharmacy program that delivers by pen, or that is not active, is not read.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Pump-delivery insulin pharmacy balance $25.00 and active CGM balance $60.00: the share is 100 percent.
- Pump-delivery insulin pharmacy balance $25.00; the CGM program is closed: 10 points are added.
- Insulin pharmacy program delivering by pen with a $90.00 balance, and no active CGM program: nothing is added.
